name: Wormhole n300 Empirical Roofline Model
description: Bachelor thesis project building an empirical roofline model of the Wormhole n300. Handwritten TT-Metal kernels measure peak DRAM bandwidth, L1 and NoC bandwidth, and matmul throughput across numerical formats and math fidelities, and a TTNN benchmark measures the same quantities through the library's own operators for comparison. Includes results and plots.
author: Taldux
